messages:
Sam: Heads up — planning a schema cutover for tenant_flags table in tonight's 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. Need final agreement on: pin commit, canary region, and rollback signal. @infra-oncall can you confirm quiesce window?
Anya: I can own the pin. propose pinning api-service to v2.14.3 for the window. will add release note snippet.
Lee: Agree on pin. Can we run the canary in eu-west-1 first (low traffic) then us-east-1? If the canary passes, auto-promote.
infra-oncall: Quiesce OK for 02:00-02:10 UTC; we should avoid long-running locks. Keep DDL under 30s and backfill streaming.
Sam: plan: 02:00 canary eu-west-1 (5% traffic), 02:10 promote to us-east canary (20%), 02:30 full split. rollback hatch if error rate > 2% or deploy-bot reports stuck locks.
Anya: I'll include this in release notes: "Tenant flags: add new nullable column rollout_state + backfill job. Pinned api-service v2.14.3 during window." Thoughts?
Lee: Sounds good. Add a safety: if any replica lag > 10s abort. Also use index build in CONCURRENT mode for the tenant_id index.
Sam: good call. concurrent index + small backfill with rate limit 200 rows/s. If backfill duration exceeds 20m we abort.
Anya: quick schema snippet:```sql
ALTER TABLE tenant_flags ADD COLUMN rollout_state varchar(16);
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_tf_tenant ON tenant_flags(tenant_id);
-- backfill: UPDATE tenant_flags SET rollout_state = 'legacy' WHERE rollout_state IS NULL LIMIT 5000;
```
Lee: For deploybot handoff: set a holdpoint before the DDL and a canary-check after index create. deploy-bot, can you create the holdpoint and set a watch on locks?
deploy-bot: deploybot: holdpoint created at 02:00 UTC for thread 1719876543. Will post status updates and abort conditions.
deploy-bot: deploybot: canary started in eu-west-1 with traffic=5%. health-checks=ok, latency within SLO.
infra-oncall: I'm watching the DB. Noted a brief table-level lock during CONCURRENT index start — expected, but keep an eye.
Sam: If the index blocks for >60s, rollback plan B: drop index attempt and continue with smaller batch backfill + feature-flagged rollout.
Anya: release note line ready and pushed to the release branch. I'll also attach the runbook in the PR. :memo:
Lee: thumbs up. I'll be on call for the window. @Sam set the runbook link here when ready.
Sam: runbook: https://repo.company/internal/runbooks/tenant_flags_cutover.md — includes exact SQL, abort checklist, and metrics to watch.
deploy-bot: deploybot: promoted canary to us-east-1 at 02:10 UTC. backfill job started with rate=200r/s.
deploy-bot: deploybot: alert: backfill batch failure rate 0.3% (within threshold). continuing.
infra-oncall: replica lag stayed <5s. index creation took 42s but no blocking observed on replicas. Good to proceed.
Sam: OK proceeding to full rollout at 02:30. Reminder: if error rate spikes or lock hold > 120s, abort and revert pin.
Anya: Revert instructions in runbook: API pin rollback -> promote previous commit tag v2.14.2 -> disable new feature flag -> resume normal traffic.
Lee: :thumbsup: Great coordination. Keep messages short in the window. I'll post a final green when full rollout completes.
deploy-bot: deploybot: full rollout completed at 02:34 UTC. No rollback required. Posting final metrics: error_rate=0.04%, avg_latency +2ms, backfill rows=143k, duration=34m.
Sam: Excellent work everyone. I'll follow up in release notes with postmortem if anything odd shows up overnight.
